notes: Refines Today from a simplified recommendation card into a single obvious daily task surface with one concise reason and compact evidence strength.
Recommendation/task typography becomes strong sans-serif while the Today page title retains the established editorial serif treatment.
Impact, Effort and Confidence use one compact row containing only existing server-provided values; no fabricated percentages or metrics are introduced.
I’ll do this reuses Apply semantics, Why this? opens Opportunity Detail, Later reuses Skip semantics, and Not relevant reuses the existing not-relevant decision.
The duplicate reasoning card is removed; Opportunity Detail remains authoritative for deeper evidence, assumptions, limitations, expiry and Knowledge Pack metadata.
Native pull-to-refresh, stale-refresh labeling, no-filler recommendation policy and cross-industry behavior remain unchanged.
Settings, Context and Feedback replace the custom Profile text headerLeft with the native/light Atlas back treatment while retaining a safe Profile fallback for deep links.
Today / History / Goals / Profile route topology remains unchanged.
Pilot Operations remains paused and is reserved to resume later as VS-35.
No API, database, migration, connector, menu/media, infrastructure, release or production deployment change is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner approved the written VS-34 Today Clarity & Navigation Consistency design after Expo harness review, prioritizing Today clarity before menu/media recovery.

VS-34 is a bounded mobile presentation/navigation correction using existing Opportunity and decision semantics; it introduces no new provider, data collection, retention, authorization, external action, release or production boundary.
Product Owner explicitly authorized proceeding with VS-34 using Superpowers + TDD through implementation and deterministic gates, with no deployment.
